item: SSD1681 positive and negative refresh-voltage measurement
operator_note: PREVGL1 minimum: 4.2 mV; PREVGH1 maximum: remained at 3.3 V; screen: no change.

diagnostic_image.refresh_profile: official 0x24-only black full refresh, 30 repeats, 5 s interval
diagnostic_image.machine_runtime: PASS; BUSY asserted and returned low; 5000 bytes per cycle

decision.reason: PREVGL1 did not become negative and PREVGH1 did not rise above the 3.3 V logic rail while the bounded refresh diagnostic was running.
decision.next_action: Replace or cross-swap the ESP32-FTS02 first. If component-level repair is chosen, inspect Q1 and the L2/D2-D4/C6-C9 boost network with power removed before considering the panel module.
